segments.name: Packaging products
segments.description: Produces and sells offset and flexo printing packaging products at the MP Production Site in the PRC.
segments.evidence: MP Group engages in the production and sale of offset printing packaging products, flexo printing packaging products at our self-operated MP Production Site in the PRC.

segments.name: Corrugated products
segments.description: Produces and sells corrugated products at the Yee Woo Production Site in the PRC.
segments.evidence: Yee Woo Group engages in the production and sale of corrugated products at our self-operated Yee Woo Production Site in the PRC.

segments.name: Packaging products supply chain management solutions
products: packaging products supply chain management solution
segments.description: Provides supply chain management for global clients who source their packaging needs from Vietnam and other ASEAN countries.
segments.evidence: We offer packaging products supply chain management solution to our customers globally.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for the packaging products, corrugated products and supply chain management services they buy, charged as a total solution.
revenueModel.evidence: We charge our customers based on the products purchased as a total solution.

changes.text: Yee Woo Paper Industry (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. began winding down its operations through voluntary liquidation in 2024.
changes.evidence: On 22 April, 2024 the Group commenced the process of substantially winding down the operations of YWSZ through voluntary liquidation.

changes.text: Millennium Printing International Limited was sold to a company owned by the controlling shareholders, completed in 2026.
changes.evidence: The disposal was completed on August 28, 2026, and the first installment of HKD 14,471,348 was received on September 14, 2026.
